DLC2311:4:t_011:2.en:
$$桂$$
「That's right... So, $$シャッコ$$... What are you going to do?」

DLC2311:4:t_011:3.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I surrender. Consider it my thanks for helping $$キリコ$$.」

DLC2311:4:t_011:4.en:
$$桂$$
「Thanks. Now I can move on without anything holding me back, too.」

DLC2311:4:t_011:5.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Looks like quite a few things have been settled.」

DLC2311:4:t_011:6.en:
Spectator
「I-it's rigged! This whole match is a farce!」

DLC2311:4:t_011:7.en:
Spectator
「At least let us see the $$レッドショルダー$$ and that pretty boy take each other down! Otherwise, how are we supposed to swallow this?!」

DLC2311:4:t_011:8.en:
$$ココナ$$
「That's enough out of you! What do you think $$キリコ$$'s and $$桂$$'s lives are worth?!」

DLC2311:4:t_011:9.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Don't be so hard on them, $$ココナ$$. I can understand how they feel.」

DLC2311:4:t_011:10.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「But don't worry, folks. The $$レッドショルダー$$ and the pretty boy are moving on.」

DLC2311:4:t_011:11.en:
Spectator
「Are they going to Battling matches in another city?! $$ナムサク$$?! $$グルフェー$$?!」

DLC2311:4:t_011:12.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「No, that's not it. They're going to fight on a much bigger stage.」

DLC2311:4:t_012:0.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「W-we are the ones... The people of $$マーティアル$$ shall attain eternity!!」

DLC2311:4:t_013:0.en:
$$桂$$
「I thought $$マーティアル$$ had lost its power, but it looks like they haven't changed.」

DLC2311:4:t_013:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「What could be giving them their power...?」

DLC2311:4:t_100:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
（A world without $$フィアナ$$... A world where the fighting goes on...）

DLC2311:4:t_101:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
（If battle itself won't leave me alone...）

DLC2311:4:t_102:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
（$$キリコ$$ has lost his reason to fight... his reason to live...）

DLC2311:4:t_102:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
（$$キリコ$$... Can you no longer fight...?）

DLC2311:4:t_103:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
（$$マーティアル$$ is after $$キリコ$$...）

DLC2311:4:t_103:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
（To restore its fallen authority...? But something inside me senses a strange, unidentifiable dread...）

DLC2311:4:t_104:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Don't worry, $$モーム$$. Even if my opponent is $$キリコ$$, I promise I'll win.」

DLC2311:4:t_104:3.en:
$$桂$$
「I've relied on you for everything until now, $$モーム$$. This time, I'm going to help you.」

DLC2311:4:t_104:4.en:
$$桂$$
「And to do that, first I'll clear out this rabble in front of me!」

DLC2311:4:t_105:0.en:
$$桂$$
「I really don't like you people! Slapping some incomprehensible label on $$キリコ$$ and chasing him around!」

DLC2311:4:t_105:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I've had that happen to me, too, and let me tell you... It's a real pain in the ass!」

DLC2311:4:t_105:2.en:
$$桂$$
「I haven't been this furious in a long time! I'm coming at you with everything I've got, so direct your grudges at me!」

review.context: Kei wins, Shako yields and the friends head for larger battlefields; combat monologues contrast Chirico's numbness with his renewed resolve.
decisions: Gotho's bigger stage means the wider war, not a different city's Battling arena.
The dying Martial fanatic's eternity declaration remains an interrupted boast.
